question: Which class of algae is commonly known as brown algae?
solution:
The corrrect answer is __**Phaeophyceae.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brown algae** is a class of algae known as **Phaeophyceae.**
 
• They are called brown algae because they contain a** pigment called fucoxanthin** which gives them their characteristic brown color.
 
• Phaeophyceae are mostly found in **cold waters **and are commonly found in the **intertidal zone.**
 
• They are important ecologically as they **provide habitat **and food for many marine organisms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rhodophyceae** is a class of algae commonly known as **red algae.**

 
 
• They are typically found in **warmer waters **and are important as a source of food and as a** component of coral reefs.**
 
 
 
• **Chlorophyceae** is a class of algae commonly known as** green algae.**
 
 
• They are found in a variety of habitats and are important as a **source of food** and as a model organism in research.
 
 
 
• **Chrysophyceae** is a class of algae commonly known as **golden algae.**
 
 
• They are found in **freshwater habitats** and are important as **a source of food **for aquatic organisms.
